answer_text: Prerequisites: Socket sites must be on Sockets v19.x or higher to use BGP summary routes, and the summary CIDR must be between /8 and /30. BGP summary routing is supported for Socket sites running v19.0 and higher. Limits/behavior: a summary route is advertised only if at least one of its more-specific routes exists in the Socket or PoP’s routing table; otherwise the summary route is withdrawn. You can aggregate multiple individual routes into a single summary and you may attach BGP communities to the summary routes as an option.
